name: Archaeologist Flagongut
summary: At Menethil Harbor, Archaeologist Flagongut keeps in touch with field researchers across the Great Sea. The dwarven scholar of the Explorers' League is staying at the Deepwater Tavern while bound for the Whelgar Excavation Site.

sections.title: A Scholar in Port
sections.body: Archaeologist Flagongut rests with a mug at the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor. Like many members of Ironforge's Explorers' League, he traveled west across Khaz Modan to help with discoveries near the Whelgar Excavation Site in the Wetlands. Though far from the high halls of the library, he keeps ties with field researchers, processing lost relics and reports carried across the Great Sea from distant expeditions.

sections.title: Ties to the Field
sections.body: Dwarven curiosity reaches beyond one continent. Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus sends Flagongut the mysterious fossil unearthed in Darkshore by the absent-minded Prospector Remtravel. Flagongut is amazed: he once brought a similar fossil to the Explorers' League's annual conference in Ironforge, convinced it held a power that could somehow be unlocked.

faq.answer: Flagongut is a dwarven researcher with the Explorers' League, staying at the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor. There he reviews excavation reports and keeps in touch with dig sites.

faq.q: Why is Flagongut at the Deepwater Tavern?
faq.answer: Flagongut came to Menethil Harbor on his way to the Whelgar Excavation Site in the Wetlands. While in port, he uses the tavern as a base for mail, incoming artifacts, and correspondence from abroad.

faq.q: How is Flagongut connected to Darkshore?
faq.answer: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus sends Flagongut Prospector Remtravel's mysterious fossil from Darkshore. It resembles one Flagongut brought to an Explorers' League conference, and he believes such fossils hold a power that can be unlocked.

faq.q: What organization does he belong to?
faq.answer: Flagongut belongs to the Explorers' League, King Magni Bronzebeard's royal society. It seeks the ancient origins, relics, and history of the dwarven race across Azeroth.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see the Explorers' League's reach in Flagongut's work at a seaside tavern, where he pieces together Titan secrets.
As an Alliance member, you can see Flagongut linking the night elf lands of Darkshore with the eastern Alliance strongholds of Khaz Modan.
